reason: Conversation 1 immediately identified the door-balance spring/cable as the likely cause, asked the right left-vs-right tension question, warned the spring is under tension, confirmed the right-hand fault, and sensibly routed to an engineer given the unit must be pulled out, though it never asked for the full model number. Conversation 2 ignored the clearly stated mechanical symptom, ran through irrelevant power, door-switch, child-lock, latch and delay-start checks despite repeated corrections, and ended with a wrong 'start control' diagnosis that never acknowledged the visible hanging spring. Conversation 1 was accurate and safe; Conversation 2 wasted the homeowner's effort and misdiagnosed the fault entirely.
